subject: move statement in if condition for zremrangeGenericCommand function (#2060)
reason: The change moves `server.dirty += deleted` inside the `if (deleted)` block in zremrangeGenericCommand (ZREMRANGEBYRANK/BYSCORE/BYLEX). When deleted != 0 both versions add the same amount; when deleted == 0 the old code added zero, a no-op. server.dirty, replies, keyspace notifications and command propagation are identical on both builds in all cases, so this is a pure refactor with no observable behaviour change and needs no scenario.
